compute_box_areas: compute the area of bounding boxes from a numpy array of shape [N, 4]
compute_pairwise_intersection: compute pairwise intersection areas between two sets of bounding boxes
compute_iou_scores: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two sets of bounding boxes
compute_ioa_scores: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two sets of bounding boxes
review_box_ops_module: review the np_box_ops module for bounding box area, intersection, IOU, and IOA operations
